summary: Twelve days to Expo on Nov 4. Reno has been clean since cleanup and Omar confirmed it. The duplicates root-cause PR #238 awaits Arjun's review. Harbor QBR is at 2pm today. Coastal is live in staging, Valley has data access, and Pinecrest's demo is Monday. Sam waits on pricing numbers.

items.text: Reno double-bookings cleaned up (TW-133 done). Maya called Omar and closed TW-134, saying the fix is in and root cause is next. Omar reports Reno ran clean this morning.
PR #238, the root-cause fix for duplicate appointments (TW-103), needs Arjun's review before it can ship. Review ticket TW-137 has no due date.
Arjun did his first backend candidate interview; the second is Friday (TW-110). He is also the reviewer for all backend PRs.
Arjun says the retry queue (TW-104) goes to production Friday Oct 23; it has been running in staging.
Nina's sync error alert (TW-105) is in progress with no due date. Arjun cited it as the answer to Harbor's question on learning of outages before they do.
Ranking is wired into the scoring API; load testing is next. TW-115 is due Oct 28.
Arjun created TW-138: Smart Slots suggestions look off for Coastal's early-morning docks. Owned by Nina, due Oct 28.
Harbor QBR is today at 2pm (TW-112). The deck covers Q3 usage, the export fix and time zone display. Arjun will speak to the Sep 28 outage; Dana may raise the weekly usage report.
Dana wants Harbor renewal terms on one page before the 2pm QBR. Maya owns TW-136, due today.
Harbor renews Oct 30 (38% of revenue). Order form sent and Dana called it routine. Reliability plan sent; timezone bug fixed.
Ridgeline is yellow health, renews Nov 20 (22% of revenue), and had a third double-booking incident this quarter. Renewal prep TW-113 is due Nov 13.
Coastal is live in staging. Valley now has data access, and its Smart Slots setup can start next week. TW-121 is due Oct 30.
Coastal and Valley need endpoint docs before going live. TW-127 is now in progress, due Oct 26.
Pinecrest live demo is booked for Monday. A third signed design partner is still needed by launch; TW-126 is due Oct 30.
Sam waits on Maya's final pricing numbers, promised by Friday Oct 23. The pricing page draft (TW-125) is in Figma and the printed one-pager also needs them.
Demo screen 3 waits for the slot picker build. Screens 1 and 2 are done; TW-119 is due Oct 30.
Leila says the slot picker must be stable by Oct 28 for the booth tablet. Design is frozen. TW-117 is due Oct 29; error states TW-135 now in progress.
Maya's October investor update (TW-111) has its draft done but needs October numbers. Due Oct 23.
Expo lead list of 40 is in progress; invites go out Friday. TW-122 is due Oct 28.
Smart Slots remains the company focus until Expo on Nov 4. Sync work was deferred unless sync worsened.
